steps.u: Add a dark mode toggle to the dashboard. It should follow the OS setting by default and remember the person's choice.

i.content: export function useTheme(){ const [t,setT]=useState(localStorage.getItem('theme')); useEffect(()=>{ if(t) document.documentElement.dataset.theme=t; else delete document.documentElement.dataset.theme },[t]); return [t,setT] }

steps.a: Using a data attribute with a prefers-color-scheme fallback means the OS setting applies until the person chooses, and the choice only needs one stored value.

reference.summary: Added a dark mode toggle to the dashboard that follows the operating system preference by default and stores an explicit choice, implemented with CSS variables switched by a data attribute.
facts: CSS variables with a data attribute

decisions.choice: switch theme with a data attribute plus a prefers-color-scheme fallback
decisions.reason: the OS setting applies until the person chooses and only one value needs storing
